modules.title: Your first Swedish conversation
modules.outcome: Introduce yourself, talk about daily life and dreams, and build clear sentences with common verbs, nouns and describing words.
modules.description: Start conversations, ask questions, use present-time verbs, talk about work and free time, and connect ideas about your dreams.

vocabularyTargets.active: Introductions, feelings, people, common help verbs, work, free time, interests and dreams.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Swedish sounds; present, command and infinitive verb forms; en/ett words; definite nouns; adjective agreement.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Introduce yourself; ask and answer simple questions; explain what you can, must and want to do; describe work, habits and a dream.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Greetings, personal details, pronouns and question words return in conversations about daily life.

story.title: The first class
story.setting: A community class and a first Swedish conversation
story.summary: Alex meets Elin and learns to share a name, home, origin, and languages before noticing the sounds inside those useful phrases. At the next class break they talk about how they feel and the people in their lives. Maja joins them to talk about her dreams.

modules.title: The past and many things
modules.outcome: Tell what happened, describe a past day, and talk about more than one person or thing.
modules.description: Use common past-tense verbs, react to news, build Swedish plurals and write a short message about your week.

vocabularyTargets.active: Past-time phrases, reactions to news, everyday actions, things at home and friendship.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Regular and irregular past forms, five noun plural groups and informal-letter structure.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Tell yesterday's story in order, count and describe things, and write to a friend.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Verb-second word order, common present verbs and linking words support longer past stories.

story.title: News and memories
story.setting: Conversations about yesterday, belongings and friendship
story.summary: Maja shares news about a test. Alex and Elin count things for a gathering and tell each other about their week.

modules.title: Everyday life
modules.outcome: Handle common conversations about health, shopping, family, time and weather.
modules.description: Practise useful language for a doctor, clothes and food, then arrange everyday plans with numbers, times and weather.

vocabularyTargets.active: Symptoms, clothes, food, quantities, family, clock times and weather.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Plural and definite adjective forms, prices, larger numbers and ordinal numbers.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Explain symptoms, shop for essentials, present family members and arrange a picnic.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Plural nouns, past actions, questions and personal information return in practical situations.

story.title: Everyday plans
story.setting: Health, shopping and a picnic with friends
story.summary: Alex and Elin talk about feeling ill, clothes and shopping, then plan food, family visits and a picnic around the weather.

modules.title: Plans, rules and complaints
modules.outcome: Invite someone, compare choices, give advice, complain politely and explain a route.
modules.description: Use object words, dates and comparisons, then practise rules, advice, formal complaints and directions.

vocabularyTargets.active: Invitations, dates, comparisons, weekdays, advice, permission, complaints and directions.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Definite plural nouns, object pronouns, comparative forms and formal-letter structure.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Agree a meeting, compare options, help a friend, write a complaint and give directions.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Time, people, modal verbs and command forms return in longer social and formal tasks.

story.title: Making arrangements
story.setting: Invitations, choices, advice and practical problems
story.summary: Maja makes plans with Alex and Elin. The friends compare films, discuss rules and solve a problem with a purchase; Henrik helps them give clear directions.

modules.title: Mine, yours and the future
modules.outcome: Explain ownership clearly and talk about plans, predictions and opinions.
modules.description: Choose possessive and reflexive forms, then distinguish intentions, predictions and personal opinions.

vocabularyTargets.active: Home and personal belongings, possessives, next-year plans, predictions and opinions.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Reflexive forms, sin/sitt/sina and four common ways to speak about the future.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Say whose things they are, describe a home, state plans and make a prediction with a reason.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Family, home, adjective agreement and help verbs support more precise personal messages.

story.title: Belongings and plans
story.setting: Everyday conversations about ownership and next year
story.summary: Alex, Elin and Maja work out whose things they have, then share plans, predictions and opinions about the coming year.

modules.title: Experience, school, work and home
modules.outcome: Discuss experiences and everyday issues, support an opinion, and describe the home and life you want.
modules.description: Move from life experience and school memories to work-life balance, housing, the environment and a first structured argument.

vocabularyTargets.active: Experience, personality, school, work, restaurants, housing, environment and opinion phrases.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Present perfect, main and subordinate clauses, cause and consequence, and argumentative-text structure.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Tell what you have done, discuss school and work, manage a restaurant visit, seek a home and argue for a view.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Past and future forms, comparisons, formal messages and linking words return in sustained speaking and writing.

story.title: The life you want
story.setting: School, work, a restaurant and the search for a home
story.summary: Alex and Maja compare experiences and school memories. With Elin and Henrik they explore work, restaurant requests, housing and environmental choices, then explain their own views.

modules.title: Getting ready: visits and calls
modules.outcome: Handle YKI dialogues about visits, news, advice and home problems, and write informal and formal messages.
modules.description: The YKI test's structure, then the book's first dialogues: a visit, good and bad news, advice, an invitation and calls about the home.

vocabularyTargets.active: Relationship, home, news, party and repair words.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Particle verbs, the conditional (skulle kunna) and s-verbs.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Answer a YKI dialogue turn as the cue asks, react to news, give advice and report a problem.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Perfect tense, subordinate clauses and formal messages from Lectures 14-22.

story.title: The YKI course begins
story.setting: Henrik's summer YKI course, Elin and Mikko's home, and calls about Alex's old flat
story.summary: Alex joins Henrik's summer YKI course and learns how the test works. He visits Elin and Mikko, hears good and bad news, gives advice before midsommar and makes the calls a leaking tap needs.

modules.title: React, tell, give your view
modules.outcome: React quickly in everyday situations, tell a short story in the past, and give a structured opinion.
modules.description: The book's reacting, telling and opinion tasks with the teacher's YKI rules and phrase banks.

vocabularyTargets.active: Apologies, compliments, refusals, condolences and opinion phrases.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Relative clauses with som and the three-part opinion text.
vocabularyTargets.functional: React in 25 seconds, tell about the past for a minute, and argue for a view.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Past tense, linking words and å ena sidan … å andra sidan.

story.title: Quick answers
story.summary: Henrik trains fast reactions. Alex gets ready for a visit, tells about his grandmother in Pune and argues with Elin about social media.

modules.title: Everyday errands
modules.outcome: Return goods, ask the way, complain, bargain and write an ad.
modules.description: The book's everyday-life theme: shops, cafés, directions, complaints and ads.

vocabularyTargets.active: Shopping, returns, directions, furniture and ad words.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Participles, both … and / neither … nor, and indirect questions.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Return a product, complain politely, bargain and sell something with an ad.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Formal complaints and directions from Lecture 14.

story.title: Buying for the new flat
story.setting: Shops, a café and the streets of Helsinki
story.summary: Alex shops for his new flat. He returns a broken coffee machine, gets lost, complains about a sofa without screws, bargains for a desk and sells his old sofa bed with an ad.

modules.title: Nature, environment and health
modules.outcome: Talk about nature and the environment, describe symptoms and act in an emergency.
modules.description: The book's nature, environment and health themes.

vocabularyTargets.active: Nature, environment, health, injury and emergency words.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Call about a permit, discuss green choices, describe symptoms and call 112.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Reasons and results from Lecture 21; health words from Lecture 9.

story.title: Summer outdoors
story.setting: Helsinki's nature, a summer cold and a small accident
story.summary: Alex needs a fishing permit, gives away furniture before the move, catches a summer cold and calls Maja after her bike accident.

modules.title: Work and studies
modules.outcome: Handle calls at work, discuss healthcare, school and the future of work.
modules.description: The book's work and studies theme.

vocabularyTargets.active: Work, meetings, salary, school and study words.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Opinion structures for facts and arguments.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Call in sick, book a meeting, ask for a raise and compare schools.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Work-life balance from Lecture 20; school words from Lecture 18.

story.title: At work
story.setting: Alex's work calls, Elin's office and Maja's school
story.summary: Alex calls in sick and books a meeting. Elin returns from a business trip and plans to ask for a raise. Maja and Alex compare school in Pune and Helsinki.

modules.title: Free time
modules.outcome: Handle library, travel and hobby situations, apply for a course and talk about free time.
modules.description: The book's free-time theme: library, bar, hotel, trains, courses and hobbies.

vocabularyTargets.active: Library, travel, hobby, culture and application words.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: The application structure and polite complaints.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Sort out a mix-up, react to a cancelled train, apply for a course and argue about exercise.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Formal messages, opinion texts and the conditional.

story.title: Library, trains and hobbies
story.setting: Libraries, stations and Alex's move into his tvåa
story.summary: A library mix-up, a lost coat ticket, a cancelled train and a course application. Alex talks about books, films and hobbies, and moves into his tvåa at the end of July.

modules.title: Society and old exam tasks
modules.outcome: Deal with authorities and insurance, and answer old YKI opinion and reacting tasks.
modules.description: The book's society theme, then the teacher's old YKI tasks.

vocabularyTargets.active: Society, authority, insurance, equality and work-life words.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Report a problem to an authority, argue on social topics and invite people to a housewarming.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: All earlier writing types return in exam form.

story.title: The new home
story.setting: Alex's new flat in Vallgård and Henrik's old exam tasks
story.summary: In his new flat Alex deals with a leak, his insurance and an authority. Henrik's old exam tasks cover gap years, grades, equality and remote work. Alex invites everyone to his housewarming.

modules.title: Final rehearsal
modules.outcome: Review the dialogue types, give final opinions under time and sit a full mock exam.
modules.description: Dialogue reviews, the last opinion rounds and a mock exam day.

vocabularyTargets.active: Review of the YKI phrase banks.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Answer every YKI speaking task type in time and write three texts in 55 minutes.

story.title: Exam ready
story.setting: The last days of Henrik's course and a mock exam day
story.summary: Dialogue reviews, the last opinion rounds and a mock exam day. Afterwards Alex signs up for the test.
